'''Whirlwind on the Mountain''' is a [[sword form]]. Other than the name, nothing is known about it. [[Rand al'Thor]] used this form with a ''[[saidin]]''-wrought blade to defend against spears thrown by [[Couladin]] and two other [[Aiel]] after returning from [[Rhuidean]] with [[Matrim Cauthon]].{{ref/book|4|34}}
